recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, textured indigo background featuring a central, large-scale title with a vibrant teal-to-purple gradient and distressed texture, surrounded by glowing golden particles and stylized yellow butterflies.
coreVisualRelationships: Large central title anchored by smaller secondary text above and below
Glowing golden accents contrasting against a deep, dark blue field
Textured, painterly surfaces within the typography mirroring the background grain
Diagonal movement created by floating butterflies and light orbs
coreInvariants: Deep indigo/navy background with vertical canvas-like texture
Iridescent gradient within the primary display type

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The main title is centered horizontally and vertically, occupying approximately 40% of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large, colorful display typography in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the central title, move up to the subtitle, then down to the credits, guided by the diagonal placement of butterflies.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Ample dark space around the text blocks to emphasize the 'magical' glow effect.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the dark background and the luminous, saturated text and particles.

letterConstructionRules: Display type features flared serifs and organic, slightly irregular curves
Secondary text uses a condensed, high-contrast serif with rounded terminals
The 'O' in the display type has a distinctive inward swirl
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'E' has a top bar that extends into a decorative flourish
The 'N' and 'A' have interlocking or overlapping qualities
The 'T' has a curved, wave-like crossbar
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A highly decorative, textured display face paired with a clean, legible condensed serif for metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the organic, flared aesthetic of the main title
Similar high-contrast and verticality for secondary text

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a dark indigo background with a vertical linen texture. Add scattered glowing golden bokeh orbs of varying sizes and two stylized yellow butterflies in the upper-left and lower-right corners.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large, centered title in a decorative serif with a teal-to-purple iridescent gradient and a distressed texture. Add secondary text in a condensed gold serif at the top and bottom.

verificationChecks: Does the main title have a multi-color gradient?

mustRedesign: Exact character names from the original credits
postGenerationChecks: Check for color harmony between the teal text and indigo background
Ensure the texture doesn't make the text unreadable
Verify the glow effects feel integrated rather than pasted on
recipe.reuseFormula: Dark Textured Background + Iridescent Decorative Type + Glowing Particle Accents = Magical Realism Aesthetic
